extName.description: Shown in the Chrome Web Store and chrome://extensions

extDescription.message: Automatically takes attendance in Google Meet and lets you export a report, with all data kept on your device.
extDescription.description: Shown in the Chrome Web Store and chrome://extensions

cmdTogglePanel.message: Show or hide the attendance panel in Meet

side_localOnly.message: All data is stored in this browser only.

panel_waiting.message: Waiting for the call to start…

panel_empty.message: No participants detected yet. Open Meet's People panel to speed up detection.

toast_copied.message: Copied. Paste into Google Sheets or Excel

toast_badBackup.message: That file is not a valid backup

popup_notInCall.message: Not in a Google Meet call

popup_notInCallHelp.message: Join a call on meet.google.com and attendance is recorded automatically. Look for the Attendance button in the bottom-right corner of Meet.

welcome_body.message: Join any Google Meet call: attendance is recorded automatically and saved here. Everything stays on this device.

meetings_sub.message: Your attendance history, stored locally in this browser.

meetings_search.message: Search by meeting, code, date, tag or participant…

meetings_empty.message: No meetings yet. Join a Google Meet call and your attendance list will appear here.

bulk_help.message: Export many meetings into one file. XLSX contains a summary sheet plus one sheet per meeting.

delete_body.message: “$1” on $2 will be permanently removed from this device.

detail_timelineTitle.message: Time in call across the meeting

detail_seriesLink.message: All sessions with this meeting code

tags_add.message: Add a tag and press Enter

analytics_sub.message: Attendance and participation across your meetings.

analytics_noSpeaking.message: No speaking time recorded in this range.

analytics_empty.message: No meetings in this range yet.

series_sub.message: Recurring meetings reuse the same Meet code. Open a series to see who attended which session.

rosters_sub.message: Expected attendees for a class or team. Link a roster to a meeting code to mark people Present, Late or Absent automatically.

rosters_noCodes.message: Not linked to a meeting code

rosters_empty.message: No rosters yet. Create one by pasting names or importing a CSV.

rosters_deleteBody.message: “$1” will be removed. Saved meetings are kept.

roster_codesHelp.message: Comma-separated. Meetings with these codes use this roster automatically.

roster_membersHelp.message: One person per line, optionally “Name, email”. Names are matched flexibly (e.g. “Md. Rahim Uddin” matches “Rahim Uddin”).

settings_sub.message: Preferences are stored locally and apply to all Meet tabs immediately.

set_autoSaveHelp.message: Save the list to your history automatically during and at the end of each call.

set_intervalHelp.message: Seconds between automatic saves while a call is running.

set_showButtonHelp.message: Floating Attendance button and live panel inside Google Meet.

set_graceHelp.message: Seconds someone must be gone before a leave is recorded.

set_chatHelp.message: Store chat messages (sender, time, text) shown in Meet's chat panel with the meeting.

set_lateHelp.message: Joining more than this many minutes after the meeting started counts as Late. 0 = off.

set_minPresence.message: Minimum time to count as present

set_minPresenceHelp.message: Less time in the call is marked “Too short”. 0 = off.

set_notifyHelp.message: Show a small toast in Meet when someone joins or leaves.

set_soundHelp.message: A short, quiet beep with each pop-up.

set_ignoreSelfHelp.message: Hide yourself from lists and exports.

set_selfNameHelp.message: Optional. Used to recognise you if Meet doesn't label you as “(You)”.

set_timeFormatHelp.message: Used in the dashboard, the in-Meet panel and exported files.

set_themeHelp.message: Follow the system, or force light or dark.

set_languageHelp.message: Follows your browser language. Available: English, বাংলা.

set_customizeHelp.message: Chrome manages extension shortcuts on its own page.

set_backupHelp.message: Download every saved meeting and roster as a JSON file.

set_restoreHelp.message: Import meetings and rosters from a backup file.

set_deleteAllHelp.message: Permanently remove all saved meetings from this browser.

wipe_body.message: Every saved attendance list will be permanently removed from this browser. This can't be undone.

privacy_sub.message: Short version: your attendance data never leaves this device.

privacy_c1.message: Display names of people in Google Meet calls you attend, as shown on screen.

privacy_c2.message: When each person was first and last seen, their time in the call and approximate speaking time.

privacy_c3.message: The meeting code, title (if visible) and start/end time, plus any tags, notes and rosters you add.

privacy_c4.message: If enabled, chat messages that Meet shows in its chat panel.

privacy_stored.message: Only in this browser's extension storage (chrome.storage.local). Uninstalling the extension deletes it.

privacy_n1.message: No servers, accounts, analytics, ads or trackers. The extension makes no network requests.

privacy_n2.message: No audio or video is recorded; speaking time comes from Meet's on-screen speaking indicator.

privacy_n3.message: Exports (CSV, XLSX, PDF, HTML, JSON) are generated locally by code bundled inside the extension.

privacy_p1.message: storage: save your settings, rosters and attendance history locally.

privacy_p2.message: meet.google.com content script: read the participant list and chat on Meet pages only.

privacy_p3.message: Keyboard shortcuts use chrome.commands, which needs no permission.

privacy_policy.message: Please respect your organisation's policies and local laws when recording attendance.
